The '''cosmic overdrive''' was a component of some [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that created a quick burst of acceleration. A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] used a cosmic overdrive during the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]] to escape the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] of two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].
